comments.author: @timcook8999
comments.text:
Interesting take, Matt, but I have to disagree on one major point. While current models are "good enough" for writing emails or basic coding, we are still so far from the real finish line.
The goal shouldn't just be better chatbots—it should be Agentic Autonomy and Scientific Discovery. Right now, AI is still just a tool that requires a human to hold its hand through every step of a process. It can't autonomously manage a complex project from start to finish, and it certainly hasn't discovered a new law of physics or a cure for a disease on its own.
If we stop pushing for higher-level reasoning and intelligence, we’re essentially saying we’re fine with AI being a fancy search engine forever. We need that "PhD-level" intelligence to move beyond just summarizing existing knowledge and start generating new knowledge. That’s where the real revolution happens! 🚀🧪
